summary: Feed s063_single to SIEM is degraded: 100% of packets are untagged and required VLANs 10, 20 are completely absent, breaking VLAN-aware detection despite all other checks being healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker/TAP is stripping 802.1Q tags before delivery (common causes: broker configured to strip VLANs, feed taken from access ports instead of trunk, or VLAN header removal feature enabled). Evidence shows 100% untagged frames with VLANs 10 and 20 never observed.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM requires VLANs 10 and 20 for segmentation, filtering and correlation. Without tags it cannot attribute traffic to the correct VLAN/tenant, causing blind spots and missed detections for those segments even though it does not need bidirectional or full-payload traffic.

recommended_fix.why: Preserving 802.1Q tags end-to-end ensures VLANs 10 and 20 arrive at the SIEM for correct classification and restores detection coverage for those segments.
